sources.measurement_method: Closed GIS ring converted to project campus coordinates with documented local geographic approximation; compare the saved Blender base ring vertex by vertex.
sources.uncertainty: The footprint is a roof/building polygon, not a surveyed wall line. NUM_LEVELS and Extrution units/source semantics are not documented; neither is used as a measured height.

sources.provider: Beta Zeta / Purdue Sigma Nu alumni newsletter (The Serpent, Fall 2019, p. 3), hosted by ePageFlip
sources.measurement_method: Visual interpretation of the captioned 1301 Tower Drive entrance and exterior images. The page identifies this as the Beta Zeta chapter house and shows a two-level composition, lighter lower masonry, red-brick upper walls, a recessed entrance/canopy, horizontal trim and a projecting side bay window. These cues are generalized in the model.
sources.uncertainty: The printed newsletter raster is perspective-distorted and partly occluded; it does not establish exact dimensions, floor elevations, roof silhouette, or unseen elevations. The pictured building is not georeferenced to a particular GIS edge.

sources.provider: Beta Zeta Chapter official website (archived/indexed content)
sources.measurement_method: Text states Beta Zeta moved to a new Tower Drive chapter house in 1991. The live domain currently serves a parking page; indexed page content is recorded through web research.
sources.uncertainty: Does not provide dimensional or facade information.

sources.measurement_method: Organization record confirms Sigma Nu Beta Zeta and the address 1301 Tower Drive, West Lafayette.
Road alignment adjacent north/northwest of the FID 758 polygon is used only as contextual support for choosing the north/northwest-facing long facade edge.
sources.uncertainty: Road geometry is volunteered mapping and does not directly measure the building facade bearing; the front selection remains an inference.

sources.provider: Tippecanoe County GIS / Schneider Geospatial ArcGIS MapServer, layer 69 (Year Built)
sources.measurement_method: Exact ParcelNo and Address query. Use year built and finished living area only as parcel context; not converted to floor count or height.
sources.uncertainty: This assessor layer does not provide stories, elevation, roof form, or wall height. Finished living area is parcel-wide and does not establish vertical geometry.

sources.provider: Sigma Nu Beta Zeta official Spring 2022 newsletter, ePageFlip-hosted
sources.page_reference: Printed p. 1 labels first-floor, second-floor, and third-floor rooms; printed p. 6 contains exterior/context photography.
sources.measurement_method: Text labels a First Floor Blue Room Area, Second Floor Bathroom, and Third Floor Study Room; supports at least three occupied floors. Photographs provide house context but do not establish exact exterior floor lines or height.
sources.uncertainty: Does not provide exterior dimensions, total wall height, exact roof form, or wall-to-roof registration. It does not prove that every floor is above grade.

sources.provider: Sigma Nu Fraternity Educational Foundation, official Beta Zeta Chapter House campaign page
sources.source_snapshot: Listed and linked from beta_zeta_chapter_house_fund_campaign page, no local image snapshot
sources.measurement_method: Official foundation page labels this image Beta Zeta Chapter House and associates the campaign with Tower Drive; image is identity/context evidence only.
sources.uncertainty: No georeferenced elevation or dimensional information; not used to estimate height or facade bearing.
